screens.title: Keyword Search

screens.title: Clip Library

screens.title: Case Notes
screens.description: Edit local demo notes and link each one to a stable fictional clip ID.

limitations: Clip identifiers, dates, transcripts, and notes are invented sample data, not in-game content.
The media illustration and clip controls are metadata-only; this package contains no footage, audio, or playback.
A parent-captured component image and independent three-screen implementation are pending.
